label: row_0
context: All substrates are primary bromides and electronically similar, yet show large rate differences. Increasing β‑branching slows reaction dramatically because steric hindrance blocks backside attack. Neopentyl bromide is nearly unreactive, illustrating that steric effects, not electronics, control these SN2 rates.
